summary.en: Child (12 kg) with fever and sore throat since yesterday, given Ascoril at home; told to stop it. Calpol 6 ml when fever is above 100, not more often than every six hours, and Augmentin Duo syrup 4 ml twice daily after food for the full seven days. Review in three days.

instructions.text: Calpol only when fever is above 100, not more than once in six hours
Give the antibiotic for the full seven days even if fever settles
